pr_title: Combine NewHead() args into a HeadOptions struct
pr_body:

+ Create `HeadOptions` struct for passing parameters to `NewHead()`. 
+ Create a `DefaultHeadOptions(overrides *HeadOptions) *HeadOptions` function for easy defaulting.

Closes #8447

issue_context.title: Combine NewHead() arguments into a HeadOptions struct in tsdb/head.go
issue_context.body:
With more and more tumables coming for the Head blocks, the list of arguments in `NewHead` is getting very big and any change to them requires a change in lot of other places which uses NewHead (example: a new option is incoming with exemplars for the queue size).

Similar to DB Options, it would be nice to club relevant `NewHead` arguments into a `HeadOptions`.
